This one is outside what I can give you. I don't set amounts for pre-workout, caffeine, or any supplement, scoops or otherwise. The label on the tub is a starting point, and a doctor or pharmacist can tell you what's right for your health, especially if you have any heart, blood pressure, or sleep issues or take other medication.

What I can help with is how you feel during training. If the pre-workout is making your sessions harder to recover from or your sleep worse, tell me and we'll adjust the programming around it. What are we working on this week?
